convert_flux2_vae_checkpoint: convert a FLUX.2 VAE checkpoint from safetensors format to diffusers AutoencoderKLFlux2 state dict format
convert_flux2_transformer: convert a FLUX.2 transformer DiT checkpoint to diffusers Flux2Transformer2DModel format for flux2-dev or klein models
build_full_flux2_pipeline: build a complete Flux2Pipeline by combining converted VAE, transformer, Mistral text encoder, tokenizer, and scheduler
load_original_checkpoint: load a FLUX.2 checkpoint from Hugging Face Hub repo or local safetensors file path
swap_scale_shift: swap the scale and shift parameters in AdaLayerNormContinuous weights to match diffusers implementation order
